provenance.post_title: Downtime Activities at the Dawnflower Library
provenance.asset_description: A small settlement of mostly wooden structures takes up most of a small clearing along a rocky coastline. Mountains and woodlands occupy the surrounding areas. A tall tower rises from the woods nearby. Other prominent features are an opulent temple of blue and white, the town’s tallest structure, and a long log flume jutting out over the sea.
